theater: 長江南岸瓜洲與京口之間皂角林

battle.name: 皂角林之戰
battle.theater: 長江南岸瓜洲與京口之間皂角林
battle.brief: 隆興元年十一月，金主完顏亮自瓜洲架浮橋渡江南下，前鋒抵長江南岸瓜洲與京口之間的皂角林。宋軍以弩陣、砲火與火攻封住林緣通道，乘夜襲燒其渡江備料，逼金軍退屯北岸。此役是采石大捷後江南岸防線的關鍵一環；卡面十字弩未見於本戰器械，軍寨牆頭與林緣的機械弩卻正是宋軍拒止騎兵與工兵的核心。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰的雙方是金國與南宋。金方由海陵王完顏亮御駕親征：隆興元年自中都率中樞主力南下，師次河南、泗州，分兵趨襄漢，另以海船自海道趨浙東，企圖多路齊渡長江、會師臨安。完顏亮之下，樞密院掌軍令，中都留守司與各路統軍司分領兵權，御駕親軍、中樞別軍與編入金籍的漢地降兵混編成軍，重騎與重甲步兵居中，攻城器械與舟船另有專司。宋方是南宋朝廷，高宗趙構在位、已萌退位之意，政事由中書門下與樞密院分掌。隆興元年朝廷以樞密使陳康伯總督江防，湯思退主張與金議和而罷職，淮上主戰之議一度抬頭又被壓下。江防的實際部署是分段的：采石、和州一線由吳璘等沿江統制官把守，瓜洲、鎮江（京口）一線由淮南大將張俊率兵接應，楚州、濠州一線由魏勝率楚北鄉兵拒守，兩浙沿海由水軍巡防。京口以西到建康的縱深，則靠建康府與各軍寨的城守。皂角林一役正落在瓜洲與京口之間這一段由宋軍防守的南岸上，與采石一線互為犄角，一在下游、一在上游，共同守住這一段江防。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Jin state and the Southern Song. On the Jin side the command lay with the Prince of Hailing, Wanyan Liang, who led the campaign in person: in the first year of Longxing he moved the central army out of Zhongdu, marched through Henan and Suzhou, sent columns toward Xiangyang and Han, and put sea-going ships into the sea to approach eastern Zhejiang, so that several armies would cross the Yangtze together and meet at Lin'an. Under Wanyan Liang the Privy Council issued the orders, the Zhongdu garrison administration and the several regional armies held the troops, and the imperial main body, the central reserve and the Han troops surrendered to Jin service were mixed into the same formations, with armoured cavalry and armoured infantry at the core and separate directorates for the siege trains and for the boats. The Song side was the Southern Song court, with Gaozong Zhao Gou on the throne and already thinking of handing power away, and the administration divided between the Secretariat and the Privy Council. In the first year of Longxing the court put Chen Kangbo in charge of the river defence as Privy Councillor; Tang Situi, who argued for a negotiated peace with the Jin, was dismissed; and the advocates of a northern offensive were raised for a time and then suppressed again. The river defence was in fact laid out in sections: the Caishi and Hezhou line was held by frontier commanders such as Wu Lin; the Guazhou and Zhenjiang line at Jingkou was taken over by the great general of the Huai country, Zhang Jun, who marched there from Jiankang; the Chuzhou and Haozhou line was held by Wei Sheng with the armed villagers of northern Chu; and the coast of the two Zhejiang was watched by the provincial fleet. Behind Jingkou toward Jiankang, the depth of the line rested on the walled towns of Jiankang fu and the garrison forts. The engagement at Zaojiao Forest fell precisely on that stretch of the south bank, between Guazhou and Jingkou, which the Song army was holding; it worked together with the Caishi line, one downstream and one upstream, to keep the whole reach of the river.
people: 兩方關鍵人物各有所主。宋方最關鍵的是中書舍人虞允文：隆興元年十月他奉命往采石宣撫、督視江上軍務，采石大捷之後並未就此罷手，而是把督視的範圍推向整段長江南岸，把采石、瓜洲、京口三處的守軍、糧秣與傳令統一調度，皂角林一線的守備、接應與夜襲都在他的指揮之下。他初到之時沿江諸軍將領互不受命，他收攏散卒、整頓次序、分派任務，軍心始定；相傳前線退卻時他拔刀衝陣、奪取首級以激士氣，此後名重一時，後世以之中興名將。南岸主戰的將領是淮南大將張俊，他自建康率眾赴鎮江，承接瓜洲、皂角林一線的正面。金方主帥完顏亮剛愎嗜殺，徵調全國精兵、耗盡府庫，一心要藉一次成功的渡江終結南宋；采石受挫後他轉兵瓜洲，架浮橋強行渡江。金廷宗室完顏元宜後來主持了海陵被弒後的善後，擁立完顏雍即位。南臣降將劉整為金人獻策，力主速取江南並指出采石與瓜洲是渡江要衝，使金人多路齊進的方略成形；楚北鄉兵首領魏勝在楚州堅守數十日，又收復和州、滁州，使金人西路不能得手，也牽制了正面金軍的兵力分配，迫金方不能把全部力量壓在瓜洲一線。
peopleEn: The decisive figures belong to both sides. The most important on the Song side was Yu Yunwen, a divisional secretary of the Secretariat: in the tenth month of the first year of Longxing he was sent to Caishi to pacify the district and supervise the river army, and after the great victory at Caishi he did not stop there but carried the scope of his supervision along the whole southern bank of the Yangtze, coordinating the garrisons, the provisions and the dispatch of orders at Caishi, Guazhou and Jingkou; the defence of the Zaojiao Forest line, the reliefs sent to it and the night attacks all stood under his command. When he first arrived the commanders along the river would not take orders from one another; he gathered in the strays, set the order of battle, assigned tasks and only then did the army settle. The account that has come down is that when the front gave way he drew his sword, ran into the enemy line and brought back a head to steady the men; his name spread far and wide afterwards and later generations ranked him among the great generals of the Song restoration. The commander in the field on the south bank was Zhang Jun, the great general of the Huai country, who marched with his men from Jiankang to Zhenjiang and took over the front at Guazhou and Zaojiao Forest. On the Jin side the supreme commander was Wanyan Liang, stubborn and bloodthirsty, who drew the whole strength of the state and emptied the treasury, determined to end the Southern Song in one successful crossing; repulsed at Caishi he turned his army on Guazhou and forced the crossing on a floating bridge. The Jin prince Wanyan Yuanyi later took charge of the settlement after the killing of Hailing and set Wanyan Yong on the throne. The Song turncoat Liu Zheng offered the Jin their plan, urging them to seize Jiangnan at once and identifying Caishi and Guazhou as the crossings on which the attack depended, so that the Jin plan of converging from several directions took shape. Wei Sheng, the head of the armed villagers of northern Chu, held the city of Chuzhou in the Huai country for a matter of weeks, then took back Hezhou and Chuzhou in Anhui by force of arms, so that the Jin western flank could not get its way and part of the Jin strength was tied down; this kept the Jin from being able to throw their whole weight onto the Guazhou line.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩（Crossbow，一一〇〇年，歐洲）在本戰的記載中沒有出現；當時江南岸上真正架在軍寨牆頭與林緣的，是中國式的蹶張弩與更強力的神臂弓。弩的原理在兩地相通：把拉力交給弩機上的鋼弦與機件，扣機即發，不必再拉開弓弦，射手只要校正望山的高低就能精確射擊，單發的破甲力道遠勝普通步弓；代價則是裝填要踏蹶張弦或用鉤提弦，準備時間數倍於拉弓，野戰中一旦被逼近就難以再用。歐洲十字弩在十一世紀末至十二世紀初走向成熟，弩臂、機匣、腳踏張弦器與觸發扳機成套出現，攻守兩方都倚之為長弓之外的第二種火力；本卡的年代正落在這個過渡期。宋軍在皂角林一線把機械弩用在四個地方：軍寨與村寨牆頭居高臨下射金騎與工兵；林緣樹叢之間以弩封住通往渡口的通道；泊在江心的漁船與舟筏上佈弩手，射擊對岸正在搭浮橋、捆紮繩索的工匠；夜襲時以弩封住營門，專打營中的探騎與鼓動者。除弩之外，宋軍還有步弓、長槍、大盾與藤牌、霹靂砲與火藥箭、火船與火箭，岸邊佈拒馬與鹿角，江上以竹索鐵索攔截漂來的木料。金軍的裝備以騎兵為主：探騎先行、控弦之士壓制射界、猛安謀克的重甲步兵扛著撞竿、雲梯與飛石，另有砲車與隨軍輜重車隊，糧秣自泗州、淮北一線分批運下，靠大批舟筏與海船渡運。宋軍的糧食則自建康、池州沿江轉運，徵用民船載兵載糧，各軍寨的儲備只夠數日。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card, a weapon of the year 1100 from Europe, does not appear in the records of this engagement; what was actually set on the wall-heads of the garrison towns and on the edge of the wood on the south bank was the Chinese-lineage drawn crossbow, the tiaozhang crossbow, together with the more powerful shenbin bow. The principle of the weapon was the same in both lands: the pull is handed over to the steel bowstring and the mechanism of the lock, the shot goes off when the trigger is released and the bowstring never has to be drawn again, and the archer only has to correct the elevation by the sight to hit accurately, a single shot carrying far more armour-piercing force than an ordinary bow. The price is that the weapon must be cocked by stepping down on the stirrup or by lifting the string with a hook, taking several times as long as drawing a bow, and once the shooter is closed with it can hardly be used again in the open field. In Europe the crossbow reached maturity between the end of the eleventh and the beginning of the twelfth century, with the bow limbs, the lock box, the foot stirrup and the trigger appearing as a set, and both sides of a siege relied on it as a second kind of firepower beside the longbow; the date on the card falls exactly in this transition. The Song used the mechanical crossbow in the Zaojiao Forest line in four ways: on the wall-heads of the garrison towns and village forts, shooting down at the Jin cavalry and the engineers; between the trees at the edge of the wood, sealing the lanes that led to the crossing; on fishing boats and rafts moored in mid-stream, where crossbowmen shot at the workmen raising the floating bridge and lashing its ropes on the far bank; and during night attacks, where crossbows covered the camp gate and were aimed at the outriders and the men making noise in the camp. Besides the crossbow the Song had foot bows, long spears, large shields and rattan shields, thunder-crash bombs and powder arrows, fire boats and fire arrows, with caltrops and deer-antler obstacles on the bank and bamboo and iron ropes set in the river against timber coming down the stream. The Jin equipment was cavalry in the main: outriders ahead, bowmen holding the line of sight, and the armoured infantry of the meng'an mouke carrying battering rams, ladders and stones for throwing, with bomb carts and trains of baggage wagons besides; their grain came down from Suzhou and the country north of the Huai in batches, carried across on great numbers of rafts and sea-going boats. The Song drew their grain by water from Jiankang and Chizhou, commandeering the private craft to carry troops and provisions, and the stores at the river garrisons lasted only a few days.
tactics: 宋方的打法是以寨固江、弩砲封林、乘夜燒器材三段並進。瓜洲方向的浮橋既成，金軍一旦在江南站穩，那條橋就不只是一件渡河的工具，還要供養大軍、囤積糧草、屯駐重兵，因此宋軍把注意力放在阻止其在南岸立足，而不是急於反攻。具體作法是：沿江各軍寨與村寨互為犄角，先以弓弩在林緣建立封鎖線，使金騎失去衝馳與放箭的空間；再以砲火覆蓋林外空地與浮橋兩端，把密集隊形打散；待金軍立足未穩、夜間營火減弱之際，派小股精兵由水陸兩路潛渡，焚燒其備在南岸的柴草、舟筏與糧車，並打擊架橋與維修浮橋的工兵，切斷正在延伸的橋面。金人的戰術則是集中一點：以御駕主力與猛安重甲在浮橋一線強行突破，騎兵掠地搜索宋軍寨位，輕裝先鋒快速插入林間，企圖分割宋軍縱深；攻城部隊在後方以撞竿、雲梯、飛石與砲車攻取宋方據點，同時分兵監視宋軍北伐方向，避免兩面受敵。兩軍在這一線反覆爭奪的點，是浮橋的南端與通往京口的陸路：誰控制這一段，誰就控制這條江防。
tacticsEn: The Song method was to hold the river with the forts, to seal the wood with crossbow and bomb fire, and to burn the engineering by night, the three taken together. Once the floating bridge at Guazhou stood, if the Jin could settle on the south bank it would no longer be merely a means of crossing: it would have to feed the army, store the grain and hold the heavy troops. The Song therefore put its attention on preventing them from establishing a footing on the south bank rather than on any quick counterattack, and the method was this: the garrison towns and village forts along the river were linked to one another, bow and crossbow fire was first built up as a blocking line along the edge of the wood so that the Jin cavalry lost the room to charge and to shoot; bomb fire then covered the open ground beyond the wood and the two ends of the floating bridge, breaking up the close formations; and when the Jin had not yet settled and the camp fires had died down in the night, small bodies of picked men crossed by water and by land to burn the firewood, rafts and baggage carts they had stacked on the south bank, and to strike at the engineers raising the bridge and keeping it in repair, cutting the deck that was still being pushed forward. The Jin tactic was concentration on a single point: the imperial main body and the armoured meng'an infantry forced the crossing on the floating bridge line, cavalry scoured the ground to find the Song fort positions, lightly equipped columns pushed quickly into the wood in the hope of splitting the Song depth; the siege troops behind them took the Song positions with battering rams, ladders, stones and bomb carts, while detachments watched the direction from which a Song northern offensive might come, so as not to be attacked on two sides. What the two sides fought over again and again on this reach was the south end of the floating bridge and the road to Jingkou: whoever held that stretch held the river defence.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。皂角林之戰見於隆興元年十一月的江防記載，按宋金曆法折算約在公元1161年12月；它緊接在同年十月十九日（公曆11月下旬）采石大捷之後，距離金主被弒的隆興元年十二月（公曆1162年1月）約一個月。皂角林一役本身的記載零散，各家說法互有出入，無法給出雙方確切人數；可以確定的是，參戰者為張俊所部由建康赴鎮江的兵、沿江各軍寨的守軍，以及楚北鄉兵的一部。金人自瓜洲架起的浮橋，宋人記為長十餘里，把江北與南岸連成一體；金人海上舟師出動的海船，宋人記為數百艘。采石一線宋軍的具體兵數，諸說從兩萬到五萬不等，總在數萬量級。金人南侵的總動員自隆興元年六月開始，歷時約八個月，宋人概稱百萬，顯係誇大，實際當在數十萬量級。楚州一線，孤軍在金主大軍圍攻下堅守數十日而城不陷。隆興二年十一月宋金訂立和約：宋稱臣、割唐鄧兩州、歲貢銀絹各二十五萬，兩年後以淮水為界正式劃定疆界。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The engagement at Zaojiao Forest appears in the river defence records of the eleventh month of the first year of Longxing, which converts to about December 1161; it came immediately after the great victory at Caishi on the nineteenth day of the tenth month of the same year (late November in the Gregorian calendar), roughly one month before the killing of the Jin ruler in the twelfth month of the first year of Longxing (January 1162). The records of the engagement at Zaojiao Forest itself are scattered and the accounts differ from one to another, and the exact numbers on either side cannot be given; what can be settled is that the troops engaged were the men Zhang Jun brought from Jiankang to Zhenjiang, the garrisons of the river forts, and a part of the armed villagers of northern Chu. The floating bridge the Jin raised at Guazhou is recorded by the Song as more than ten li in length, joining the north bank to the south bank into one line; the sea-going ships the Jin fleet put to sea are recorded by the Song as numbering in the hundreds. The exact strength of the Song force on the Caishi line is given differently, from twenty thousand to fifty thousand, in general a matter of several tens of thousands. The general mobilisation of the Jin for the invasion began in the sixth month of the first year of Longxing and ran for about eight months; the Song habitually spoke of a million men, which is plainly an exaggeration, the real figure being of the order of several hundred thousand. On the line of Chuzhou in the Huai country a small force held the city against the main army of the ruler in person for a matter of weeks without its falling. In the eleventh month of the second year of Longxing the Song and the Jin concluded a treaty: the Song should call itself a subject, Tang and Deng were to be ceded, and silver and silk were to be paid yearly to the value of two hundred and fifty thousand each, the frontier being formally drawn along the Huai two years later.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因，是金主完顏亮一方的渡江計畫與南宋的江防部署正面撞在一起。金自海陵王即位後一心要一統南北，先遷都燕京、再遷汴京，把國家重心壓向南面；隆興元年他把宗室完顏元宜拘在汴京、清理異己，國內異議者眾，便以大規模南征作為轉移矛盾的出口。金人的算計是趁江南無備，一次渡江直取臨安，滅宋而不必深陷淮南；降將劉整的獻策更指出采石、瓜洲一線守備空虛、渡江可以成功。宋方在隆興元年先起宿將主持淮上軍務、籌議收復兩淮，旋因主戰與主和之爭被罷，江防力量一度北調；朝廷又面對兩難：若全力北伐則淮南可復而長江空虛，若專守江防則兩淮長期淪陷。采石大捷之後，宋廷把重心轉回沿江，虞允文得以總督江上軍務，張俊自建康赴鎮江接應，而金人已把浮橋架到江南岸，兩軍在瓜洲至京口之間必然相遇。金人迫切的理由很清楚：浮橋一旦在南岸失去掩護與據點，就只是一條可以隨時被截斷的繩索，整支遠征軍會被卡在江北與江南之間的江面上無法展開。
causeEn: The cause of this war was the direct collision between the Jin plan for a crossing and the Song deployment along the river. Since taking the throne the Prince of Hailing had set his mind on uniting north and south: first he moved the capital to Yanjing and then to Bianjing, pressing the weight of the state southward; in the first year of Longxing he held the clan prince Wanyan Yuanyi at Bianjing and cleared out those who disagreed with him, and since opposition at home was general he used a great southern campaign as the outlet for that tension. The Jin calculation was to fall on an unprepared Jiangnan, cross the river in one stroke, take Lin'an and destroy the Song without being drawn deep into the Huai country; the advice of the turncoat Liu Zheng reinforced this by pointing out that the Caishi and Guazhou line was thinly held and that the river could be crossed. On the Song side the court in the first year of Longxing first brought an old general forward to direct the armies in the Huai and planned to retake the Two Huai, then removed him as the war party and the peace party quarrelled, and the strength meant for the river defence was drawn north for a time. The court was also in a double dilemma: if it threw everything into a northern offensive the Huai country might be recovered but the river would lie open, and if it did nothing but guard the river the Two Huai would remain lost for long. After the great victory at Caishi the court turned its weight back to the river, Yu Yunwen was able to take the overall charge of the river army, and Zhang Jun marched from Jiankang to relieve Zhenjiang, while the Jin had already carried their floating bridge over to the south bank; the two armies were bound to meet between Guazhou and Jingkou. The Jin urgency is easy to state: once the floating bridge on the south bank lost its cover and its foothold it was only a rope that could be cut at any moment, and the whole expedition would be stuck in the water between the two banks with no room to deploy.
impact: 就當時而言，這場戰爭的直接影響是金人渡江的總計畫在江南岸被卡住。采石一役破其東路，皂角林一役擋住其西路，完顏亮的南征由攻勢轉為僵局；其本人隨即在瓜洲被部將所弒，軍中秘不發喪，盡斂金帛、載運糧草北還，淮南與兩淮諸城相繼收復。宋廷由此換來喘息之機，隆興二年宋軍一度北伐，隆興和議隨即取代戰爭：宋以稱臣、割地、歲幣換取以淮水為界的相對均勢，此後近一個世紀南北維持靜態平衡，南宋得以再延百五十年，到一二七九年才亡於元。技術上的啟示同樣具體：機械弩在守城、林地、舟船這種射界固定而敵我難以迴避的環境裡，價值遠高於野戰；宋軍用弩陣、砲火與火攻配合，把金人最倚重的渡江工程變成可以摧毀的目標，這與同時代歐洲城堡攻防中弩手與配重投石車各司其事的格局是相通的。對兵家而言，皂角林一役還說明一條常被忽略的道理：決定江防的不是射程，而是渡口與器材的存亡。
impactEn: For the time, the direct effect of this war was that the Jin plan for a crossing was stopped dead on the south bank. The engagement at Caishi broke their eastern flank and the engagement at Zaojiao Forest held their western one, and the southern campaign of Wanyan Liang turned from an offensive into a stalemate; he was then killed by his own officers at Guazhou, the death was kept secret, the treasure was loaded up, the grain was carried away and the army returned north, city after city of the Huai country being given back. The court thus gained room to breathe; in the second year of Longxing the Song struck north for a time, and the Longxing settlement soon took the place of the war: the Song bought a relative balance along the Huai with the price of calling itself a subject, ceding territory and paying tribute, and for close to a century afterwards north and south kept a static balance, so that the Southern Song survived for another hundred and fifty years and did not fall to the Yuan until 1279. The lesson in technique is just as concrete: the mechanical crossbow was worth far more in a walled town, in woodland and on boats, where the field of fire was fixed and the enemy could not easily slip away, than it was in the open field. The Song matched crossbow line, bomb fire and fire attack to turn the crossing works on which the Jin relied most into a target that could be destroyed; this is of a piece with the pattern in the castle sieges of contemporary Europe, where crossbowmen and counterweight trebuchets each had their own part. To the military writers the engagement at Zaojiao Forest also set out a truth often overlooked: what decides a river defence is not the range of a weapon but the survival of the crossing point and of the engineering.
result: 就結果而言，皂角林一線的守軍頂住了金軍自瓜洲南下的先頭部隊，使其無法在江南岸穩固立營，江北與南岸之間的浮橋始終暴露在弩砲與火攻之下；金軍在采石受挫、皂角林再遭抵抗之後，攻勢耗盡，完顏亮退屯瓜洲，隨即在隆興元年十二月被部將所弒，大軍北撤。宋軍乘勢收復泗州、楚州等處，隆興二年一度北伐而不能持久，和議取代戰爭，南宋的國祚因此再延百五十年。就裝備而言，本戰給出的答案很清楚：弩這種把拉力交給機件的武器，靠的是弩機、望山與鋼弦，而不是射手的手臂與體力；它單發準確、破甲力強，卻極不適合野戰機動，一旦守軍退到林外或寨牆被突破就再也無法發揮。金人的騎兵、撞竿與雲梯在浮橋一線無法施展，宋人的砲火與火箭卻能把浮橋與工兵一併吞掉。歷代記錄對這一役的細節說法不一，本戰的史實仍可確定者如下：它發生在隆興元年十一月的江南岸、瓜洲與京口之間；它是采石大捷之後宋軍江防的延續；它延緩並最終配合了金人南侵的崩潰；它同時是南宋得以續命、並以和議換取百五十年邊界安定的一環。
resultEn: As for the outcome, the troops on the Zaojiao Forest line held off the leading elements that the Jin had sent south from Guazhou and stopped them from establishing a stable camp on the south bank, so that the floating bridge between the two banks stayed under the fire of the crossbows, the bombs and the fire; after the repulse at Caishi and the renewed resistance at Zaojiao Forest the Jin offensive ran out of strength, Wanyan Liang fell back on Guazhou and was there killed by his own officers in the twelfth month of the first year of Longxing, and the army withdrew north. The Song took back Suzhou, Chuzhou and other places in the movement, struck north for a time in the second year of Longxing without being able to keep it up, and a negotiated settlement took the place of the war, so that the Southern Song was given another hundred and fifty years of life. As to the equipment, this war gives a clear answer: a weapon like the crossbow, which hands the pull over to a mechanism, depends on the lock, the sight and the steel string and not on the arm and the strength of the archer; its single shot is accurate and armour-piercing, yet it is badly unsuited to movement in the open field, and once the defenders were pushed out beyond the wood or the wall of the fort was broken it could no longer be used at all. The cavalry, the battering rams and the ladders of the Jin could not be brought to bear on the floating bridge line, while the bomb fire and the fire arrows of the Song swallowed the bridge and the engineers together. The records of later ages differ on the details of this engagement, but the following can be settled: it took place on the south bank of the Yangtze in the eleventh month of the first year of Longxing, between Guazhou and Jingkou; it was the continuation of the Song river defence after the great victory at Caishi; it delayed, and in the end helped bring about, the collapse of the Jin invasion; and it was at the same time one of the links in the chain by which the Southern Song kept its life and bought a hundred and fifty years of settled frontier by treaty.
